description: Defines the class FirestorePaths which provides static methods to generate references to Firestore collections and documents for users, projects, tags, and tasks within a project management Flutter app.

classes.name: FirestorePaths
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to access Firestore paths related to users, projects, tags, and tasks.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns a reference to the 'users' collection in Firestore.

methods.name: projectsCollection
methods.description: Returns a reference to the 'projects' collection for a specific user.

methods.name: projectDoc
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific project document for a user.

methods.name: tagsCollection
methods.description: Returns a reference to the 'tags' collection for a specific user.

methods.name: tagDoc
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific tag document for a user.

methods.name: tasksCollection
methods.description: Returns a reference to the 'tasks' collection for a specific user.

methods.name: taskDoc
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific task document for a user.
